#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strictly read-only probe: verify EDUUSDT 2026-06 raw duplicate-key conflict
is correctly excluded in normalization conflicts, lineage, QA, and the
executable manifest cells.  This script never writes to the audited store."""
import csv
import hashlib
import io
import json
import re
import zipfile
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/data/k3/p5_pc6_binance_data_v1")
EDU = "data/spot/monthly/klines/EDUUSDT/1h/EDUUSDT-1h-2026-06.zip"
MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"-(20\d{2}-\d{2})\.zip$")


def sha_file(p: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def load_jsons(rel: str) -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted((ROOT / rel).glob("*.json"))]


report: dict = {}

# ---- plan ----
cur = (ROOT / "plans" / "CURRENT").read_text().strip()
plan = json.loads((ROOT / "plans" / f"enumeration-{cur}.json").read_text())
plan_keys = [o["key"] for o in plan["objects"]]
plan_cells = [(c["symbol"], c["month"]) for c in plan.get("executable_cells", [])]
edu_obj = [o for o in plan["objects"] if o["key"] == EDU]
report["plan"] = {
    "current_enumeration": cur,
    "object_count": len(plan_keys),
    "executable_cell_count": len(plan_cells),
    "edu_cell_planned": ("EDUUSDT", "2026-06") in plan_cells,
    "edu_object": edu_obj[0] if edu_obj else None,
}

# ---- revisions ----
raw_idx = {}
for r in load_jsons("raw/revisions"):
    raw_idx[r["remote_object_identity"]] = r
norm_identities = [r["remote_object_identity"] for r in load_jsons("normalized/revisions")]
report["revisions"] = {
    "raw_count": len(raw_idx),
    "normalized_count": len(norm_identities),
    "edu_in_normalized": EDU in norm_identities,
}

# ---- raw blob duplicate evidence ----
edu_rev = raw_idx.get(EDU)
blob_info = None
if edu_rev:
    blob = Path(edu_rev["raw_storage_locator"])
    if blob.exists():
        with zipfile.ZipFile(blob) as z:
            member = z.namelist()[0]
            rows = list(csv.reader(io.TextIOWrapper(z.open(member), encoding="utf-8")))
        header = rows[0]
        data = rows[1:]
        cnt = Counter(r[0] for r in data)
        dups = {k: v for k, v in cnt.items() if v > 1}
        blob_info = {
            "blob_exists": True,
            "member": member,
            "header": header[:7],
            "data_rows": len(data),
            "unique_open_time": len(cnt),
            "duplicate_open_time_keys": len(dups),
            "first_duplicates": [{"open_time": k, "count": v} for k, v in list(dups.items())[:5]],
        }
    else:
        blob_info = {"blob_exists": False, "locator": str(blob)}
report["edu_raw_revision"] = (
    {k: edu_rev.get(k) for k in (
        "revision_id", "remote_object_identity", "checksum_status", "raw_sha256",
        "raw_byte_size", "dataset", "symbol", "month", "source_published_at",
        "retrieval_timestamp", "source_url")}
    if edu_rev else None
)
report["edu_raw_blob"] = blob_info

# ---- normalization conflicts ----
conflicts = load_jsons("normalized/conflicts")
conf_by_key = {c["key"]: c for c in conflicts}
report["conflicts"] = {
    "count": len(conflicts),
    "keys": sorted(conf_by_key),
    "entries": conflicts,
}

# ---- normalization result ----
ncur = (ROOT / "normalization_results" / "CURRENT").read_text().strip()
nres = json.loads((ROOT / "normalization_results" / f"result-{ncur}.json").read_text())
report["normalization_result"] = {
    "current": ncur,
    "objects_planned": nres.get("objects_planned"),
    "objects_succeeded": nres.get("objects_succeeded"),
    "objects_failed": nres.get("objects_failed"),
    "objects_excluded": nres.get("objects_excluded"),
    "exclusions": nres.get("exclusions"),
    "failures": nres.get("failures"),
}

# ---- artifacts (all manifest-bearing dirs) ----
report["manifests_found"] = [
    {
        "path": str(mf),
        "generated_at": json.loads(mf.read_text()).get("generated_at"),
        "status": json.loads(mf.read_text()).get("status"),
    }
    for mf in sorted(Path("/data/k3/worktrees").glob("*/artifacts/*/P5_PC6_EXECUTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST_V1.json"))
]

audits = []
for mf in sorted(Path("/data/k3/worktrees").glob("*/artifacts/*/P5_PC6_EXECUTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST_V1.json")):
    base = mf.parent
    manifest = json.loads(mf.read_text())
    lineage = json.loads((base / "P5_PC6_DATA_REVISION_LINEAGE_V3.json").read_text())
    qa = json.loads((base / "P5_PC6_BINANCE_STRUCTURAL_QA_V1.json").read_text())
    a: dict = {}
    a["manifest"] = str(mf)
    a["hash_refs_ok"] = {
        "lineage": manifest["data_revision_lineage_sha256"]
        == sha_file(base / "P5_PC6_DATA_REVISION_LINEAGE_V3.json"),
        "qa": manifest["structural_qa_sha256"] == sha_file(base / "P5_PC6_BINANCE_STRUCTURAL_QA_V1.json"),
    }
    edu_line = [r for r in lineage["revisions"] if r.get("remote_object_identity") == EDU]
    a["lineage"] = {
        "revision_count": lineage["revision_count"],
        "rows": len(lineage["revisions"]),
        "edu_row": edu_line[0] if edu_line else None,
    }
    lineage_keys = {r.get("remote_object_identity") for r in lineage["revisions"]}
    a["lineage_integrity"] = {
        "plan_objects_without_lineage_row": sorted(set(plan_keys) - lineage_keys),
        "conflict_keys_missing_excluded_status": sorted(
            k for k in conf_by_key
            if not any(
                r.get("remote_object_identity") == k
                and r.get("normalization_status") == "EXCLUDED_SOURCE_ARCHIVE_CONFLICT"
                for r in lineage["revisions"]
            )
        ),
    }
    a["qa"] = {
        "duplicate_keys": qa.get("duplicate_keys"),
        "normalization_failures": qa.get("normalization_failures"),
        "source_archive_conflict_keys": [c["key"] for c in qa.get("source_archive_conflicts", [])],
        "executable_cell_count": qa.get("executable_symbol_month_cells"),
        "edu_in_wave1": any(s == "EDUUSDT" for s in qa.get("wave1_complete_symbols", [])),
        "edu_in_t1": any(s == "EDUUSDT" for s in qa.get("t1_engineering_window_complete_symbols", [])),
    }
    cells = manifest.get("executable_cells", [])
    a["manifest_executable"] = {
        "count": len(cells),
        "edu_cells": [c for c in cells if c.get("symbol") == "EDUUSDT"],
        "status": manifest.get("status"),
        "edu_raw_revision_in_raw_ids": bool(
            edu_rev and edu_rev["revision_id"] in manifest.get("raw_archive_revision_ids", [])
        ),
        "raw_archive_revision_id_count": len(manifest.get("raw_archive_revision_ids", [])),
    }
    # cell conservation: manifest cells == plan cells minus cells touched by a conflict
    conflicted_cells = set()
    for ck in conf_by_key:
        mth = MONTH_RE.search(ck)
        if not mth:
            continue
        name = ck.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        conflicted_cells.add((name.split("-")[0], mth.group(1)))
    manifest_cells = {(c["symbol"], c["month"]) for c in cells}
    a["cell_conservation"] = {
        "plan_cell_count": len(plan_cells),
        "conflicted_cells": sorted(conflicted_cells),
        "manifest_cell_count": len(manifest_cells),
        "plan_minus_manifest": sorted(set(plan_cells) - manifest_cells),
        "unexpected_in_manifest": sorted(manifest_cells - set(plan_cells)),
        "exact_expected": manifest_cells == set(plan_cells) - conflicted_cells,
    }
    audits.append(a)
report["artifact_audits"] = audits

print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
